description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing fence timing, including FenceTime, FenceTimeline, and FenceToFenceTimeMap, used for synchronization and testing within Android's graphics framework.

classes.name: FenceTime
classes.description: Represents a wrapper around a Fence object, providing thread-safe access to its validity and signal time.

classes.name: FenceTime::Snapshot
classes.description: An atomic, flattenable snapshot of FenceTime's state, including fence reference and signal time.

classes.name: FenceTimeline
classes.description: A FIFO queue managing FenceTime objects expected to signal, with thread-safe push and update operations.

classes.name: FenceToFenceTimeMap
classes.description: A test utility class that maps Fences to FenceTime objects, allowing simulation of fence signaling for testing purposes.

methods.name: applyTrustedSnapshot
methods.description: Replaces the current FenceTime state with a trusted snapshot.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the FenceTime object is valid.

methods.name: getSignalTime
methods.description: Retrieves the fence's signal timestamp, querying the fence if necessary.

methods.name: getCachedSignalTime
methods.description: Returns the cached signal timestamp without querying the fence.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a current snapshot of the FenceTime object.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the fence to signal up to a specified timeout.

methods.name: signalForTest
methods.description: Simulates a fence signal for testing.

methods.name: createFenceTimeForTest
methods.description: Creates a FenceTime object for testing, wrapping a given Fence.

methods.name: signalAllForTest
methods.description: Signals all FenceTime objects associated with a specific Fence for testing.
